way_of_the_sword.name: Way of the Sword
way_of_the_sword.description: This sect venerates the sword above all other weapons. The blade is an extension of the self.

strength_is_justice.name: Strength is Justice
strength_is_justice.description: The weak are meat, the strong do eat. Power alone determines right from wrong.

ascetic_vows.name: Ascetic Vows
ascetic_vows.description: Rejects all worldly pleasures. The body is a vessel for Qi, not indulgence.

purity_of_heart.name: Purity of Heart
purity_of_heart.description: Karma is everything. Acts of compassion compound in the spirit as surely as meridian refinement.

guardian_of_jianghu.name: Guardian of the Jianghu
guardian_of_jianghu.description: This sect considers itself the protector of the weak and the upholder of righteous law in the martial world.

scholarly_tradition.name: Scholarly Tradition
scholarly_tradition.description: The pen and the sword are one. This sect maintains libraries, trains scholars, and holds knowledge sacred.

blood_sacrifice.name: Blood Sacrifice
blood_sacrifice.description: Power is drawn from life itself. Ritual sacrifices fuel the sect's cultivation. The weak exist to serve the strong.

forbidden_arts.name: Forbidden Arts
forbidden_arts.description: The sect traffics openly in techniques banned by the orthodox world. Power through transgression.

master_and_slave.name: Master and Slave
master_and_slave.description: Absolute hierarchy. The master's word is law. Disciples surrender all autonomy in exchange for cultivation resources.

merchant_ways.name: Merchant Ways
merchant_ways.description: Wealth fuels cultivation. This sect maintains trade networks and treats resources as a form of spiritual merit.

wanderer_sect.name: Wanderer Sect
wanderer_sect.description: This sect has no fixed home. Members roam the Jianghu freely, gathering experience and avoiding entanglements.

balance_of_qi.name: Balance of Qi
balance_of_qi.description: Neither purely orthodox nor demonic, this sect seeks harmony between opposing forces in cultivation.

innovation_above_tradition.name: Innovation Above Tradition
innovation_above_tradition.description: Ancient techniques are starting points, not destinations. This sect actively creates new martial knowledge.

eclectic_methods.name: Eclectic Methods
eclectic_methods.description: This sect borrows from every tradition without belonging to any. Disciples study weapons, alchemy, and mental arts equally.

terror_doctrine.name: Terror Doctrine
terror_doctrine.description: Fear is the sect's primary resource. Reputation built on atrocity ensures no enemy dares approach.
